items.title: Remove legacy public mutations and bind every scoped request to its target workspace
items.summary: Fail closed on ambiguous scope and separate stack authority from workspace roles.
acceptance: Scoped requests resolve the target workspace before handler execution.
Ambiguous or missing resource scope fails closed.
The two-workspace adversarial authorization matrix passes.
items.stop_line: Do not reopen unless a scoped-resource regression is found.

items.title: Make credential use capability-based, non-retrievable, atomic, and revocable
items.summary: Move credential authority behind typed vault reads, durable generations, opaque leases, and fail-closed OAuth handling.
acceptance: Typed vault reads distinguish missing, sealed, corrupt, unavailable, and ok.
Binding lifecycle state and monotonically increasing capability generation are durable.
Leases are generation-bound and stale generations are rejected.
Replacement, disconnect, revoke, expiry, restore, and payer changes revoke prior generations.
Reusable OAuth material is migrated or quarantined and never published to runtime auth.json.
Interruption, migration, revocation, recovery, and raw-secret scan fixtures pass.
items.stop_line: No public multi-user beta claim until replacement, removal, restore, and expiry revocation fixtures pass.

items.title: Persist runtime ownership, endpoints, secrets, and idempotent mutation identity
items.summary: Make runtime mutations recoverable and safe to retry after WF-048.
acceptance: Runtime ownership and endpoint identity survive restart and restore.
Mutations have durable idempotency identity and resumable recovery.
items.stop_line: No automatic mutative retry until ownership and idempotency are durable.

items.title: Bound HTTP input and distinguish failures from valid empty state
items.summary: Reject malformed or oversized input and make backend failures explicit.
acceptance: Strict bounded request-body and pagination parsing runs before dispatch.
Malformed input returns stable client errors.
Database and internal failures never masquerade as empty success.
evidence: PR #28 merged after CI verify succeeded
items.stop_line: No production-ready API claim while malformed input or backend failure can masquerade as valid empty state.

items.title: Make one immutable installation manifest the updater source of truth
items.summary: Prevent package, running component, and updater identity drift.
acceptance: The package pins one immutable installation manifest.
Running components report the same identity used by the updater.
items.stop_line: Do not freeze beta while running component identity can disagree with the package pin.

items.title: Scope Hermes profile operations and revoke long-lived room access
items.summary: Carry workspace and revocation authority through profile and stream operations.
acceptance: Profile operations remain bound to the target workspace and user.
Long-lived room and stream access is revoked when authority changes.
items.stop_line: No external multiplayer beta until profile and stream authority survives revocation matrices.

items.title: Freeze and prove one immutable baseline across all four Workframe instances
items.summary: Operator acceptance of the exact packed artifact across the target cells.
acceptance: One immutable package/config baseline passes the four target-cell matrix.
Cross-workspace, raw-key, runtime-ownership, restore, and revocation matrices are recorded.
items.stop_line: Requires deployment credentials, invited identities, backup/restore exercise, and exact artifact evidence.

items.title: Unify CLI, Electron, Architectonic bootstrap, runtime adapters, and generative organization UI
items.summary: Future product architecture after the security rail is complete.
acceptance: One versioned bootstrap plan is consumed by cloud, local, and Electron surfaces.
A second runtime adapter is added only after the Hermes contract is stable.
items.stop_line: Do not market future adapters or generative UI as shipped.

items.title: External multi-user beta promotion
items.summary: Operator promotion after all P0 security and acceptance rails are complete.
acceptance: Every required source, package, runtime, restore, and target-cell matrix is green.
The operator explicitly approves the named artifact for beta.
items.stop_line: No external invitation or production-ready claim before explicit operator promotion.

extensions.vision: Start a security-first semi-autonomous multiplayer AI organization through one reviewed Architectonic plan, with Workframe as the shared UI/workspace/supervision surface and Hermes as the first replaceable runtime adapter.

authority.stack_operator: operates one installation and release surface; does not inherit workspace or secret-retrieval authority
authority.workspace_role: resolved in the target workspace for every workspace-owned resource
authority.user_proxy: private runtime, capability, memory, payer, and session context bound to one user and one shared workspace agent identity
authority.credential: raw upstream secret is non-retrievable through normal product APIs
authority.apply: writes, deployment, adoption, and destructive operations require explicit immutable plan authority
